description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $80 - $120 per hour 
 
 Employment Type: W-2 Employment
 Work Commitment: Minimum 20 hours per week.
 Availability: Consistent availability during weekdays.
 Work Focus: AI model training, software engineering task development, code evaluation, reference solution creation, and technical feedback.
 
 We are seeking experienced Software Engineers to contribute to the development, training, and evaluation of next-generation Generative AI models. This role offers an opportunity to leverage strong software engineering expertise to improve the accuracy, reliability, and problem-solving capabilities of advanced AI systems.
 The ideal candidate should have extensive hands-on experience in production software development, with strong proficiency in Python and at least one additional programming language such as Java, C++, Go, or Rust. A solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, backend engineering, systems design, and software development best practices is essential.
 The role involves creating complex programming challenges, developing reference solutions, evaluating AI-generated code, and providing expert technical feedback to improve AI model performance across real-world software engineering scenarios.
 This is a W-2 employment opportunity with the possibility of working as part of the extended workforce of a leading AI research organisation.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 A. AI Model Training & Technical Expertise 
 Collaborate with AI research and engineering teams to identify technical knowledge gaps and improve AI model performance across software engineering, programming, algorithms, and systems design.
 Apply practical software development experience to assess the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of AI-generated code.
 Provide expert guidance on programming concepts, backend development, system architecture, and engineering best practices.
 Help improve AI models' ability to solve complex software engineering problems through structured training and evaluation.
 B. Technical Task Development & Solution Design 
 Design challenging, domain-specific programming tasks covering software engineering, algorithms, data structures, and backend development.
 Develop accurate, efficient, and well-documented reference solutions for complex coding problems.
 Create realistic multi-file coding assignments that reflect production-level software development scenarios.
 Write, review, and debug code across Python and other programming languages, including Java, C++, Go, and Rust.
 Develop unit tests and validation frameworks to ensure solutions execute correctly and meet defined requirements.
 C. Code Review & Technical Evaluation 
 Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, maintainability, and adherence to software engineering standards.
 Review and debug complex coding solutions, identifying logical errors, performance issues, and architectural weaknesses.
 Assess code quality, test coverage, error handling, and implementation approaches.
 Provide clear, detailed, and actionable technical feedback to improve AI-generated programming outputs.
 Evaluate different approaches to solving engineering problems and assess their practical trade-offs.
 D. Evaluation Framework & Benchmark Development 
 Develop structured evaluation rubrics to assess programming accuracy, code quality, design decisions, and test coverage.
 Establish benchmarks for algorithms, data structures, backend systems, and production software engineering tasks.
 Create comprehensive test cases to evaluate the reliability and robustness of AI-generated solutions.
 Collaborate with other software engineering experts to ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality across AI training datasets.
 E. Engineering Collaboration 
 Work closely with AI researchers, software engineers, and other subject matter experts.
 Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and solution validation exercises.
 Ensure that technical tasks and reference solutions reflect industry-standard software development practices.
 Contribute domain expertise to improve the overall quality of AI training and evaluation processes.
 Must-Have Skills & Qualifications
 4+ years of professional experience in Software Engineering or Software Development.
 Strong production-level proficiency in Python.
 Hands-on expertise in at least one additional programming language: Java, C++, Go, or Rust.
 Strong understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
 Experience in backend development, systems programming, and software architecture.
 Hands-on experience with Git, version control workflows, code reviews, and collaborative development.
 Strong understanding of automated testing, unit testing, debugging, and Continuous Integration (CI).
 Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining production-grade software applications.
 Demonstrated professional growth and increasing ownership of software engineering responsibilities.
 Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
 Good-to-Have Skills
 Experience designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures.
 Knowledge of microservices, APIs, and system design principles.
 Experience with performance optimisation and debugging complex applications.
 Familiarity with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
 Exposure to AI/ML development, generative AI, or large language model evaluation.
 Experience in technical mentoring, documentation, code reviews, or engineering assessments.
 Previous experience creating coding challenges, technical benchmarks, or reference implementations.
 
 Preferred Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is a technically strong Software Engineer with substantial production development experience and expertise in Python alongside Java, C++, Go, or Rust.
